the MI measure shows a clear 6–bp periodicity in noncoding promoter sequences.
human promoter sequences show an enhanced mutual information (i.e., predictability) at a distance of six bases.

human promoter sequences show a periodicity at 6 bps, which is not a harmonic of the 3–bp periodicity of coding DNA.
